title: INVESTIGATING THEMATIC PATTERNS AND USER PREFERENCES IN LLM INTERACTIONS USING BERTOPIC
reasoning: The study extracts 'Social Issues and Ethical Dilemmas' (Topic 8) as one of the 29 core thematic clusters from LLM interaction data. It then explicitly evaluates and benchmarks the win rates of various LLMs specifically for this topic, providing performance metrics like gpt-4-0314's 49.97% win rate in this category.
